title: Jedan dan
description: “One Day,” Yugoslavia’s entry at the 1968 Eurovision Song Contest, sung by the Dubrovnik Troubadours. The band, founded by local composer Đelo Jusić, performed in medieval costume and became one of Yugoslavia’s best-known groups.

title: Muzika i ti
description: “Music and You,” Yugoslavia’s 1972 Eurovision song. Tereza Kesovija, born in Dubrovnik in 1938, became one of Yugoslavia’s biggest stars and also had a career in France. Her family house near the city was destroyed in the 1991 war.
